Name: Slightly Recolored Volcano
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=5][b]Information:[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]This mod recolors the volcano in Ginger Island slightly. Randomizes between 3 different colors![/size]

[size=5][b]Installation: [/b][/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy!  [/size]

Downloads.Description: Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6. Unzip into your Mods folder.
